question: Which Indian-origin chemist won the 2020 Millennium Technology Prize along with Prof David Kleinerman in May 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is**__ Shankar Balasubramanian.__** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Shankar Balasubramanian and Prof David Kleinerman got this award in May 2021 for the invention of Next Generation DNA Sequencing.

 
• **Millennium Technology Prize**
 
• One of the** world's largest technology prizes.**
 
• It is awarded **once every two years by Technology Academy Finland.**
 
• The **Patron of this prize is the President of Finland.**
 
• **This award is for Life Enhancing Technological Innovation.**
 
• **Established: 2002 **
 
• **The prize was inaugurated in 2004.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Technology Academy Finland is **an** independent foundation established by Finnish industries, academic institutions, and the state of Finland.**
